pages.text: The $(item)Deployer$() is a mechanical player hand. Given rotation, it does what you do: place blocks, use items, activate blocks, harvest and attack mobs. It acts on the position two blocks in front of it.

pages.title: Deployer
pages.text: Right-click its front to give it an item. A wrench switches between right-click and left-click mode.

In automation it $(thing)applies items to other items$(). Held item over a belt or depot item: the combination is an assembly step. This is how a machine adds cogwheels, sand paper or ingredients.$(br2)It also feeds $(l:create_basics/heat)Blaze Burners$(/l) fuel.

A negative redstone pulse triggers one cycle. On a $(l:create_basics/contraptions)contraption$(/l), deployers act at every place they pass, pulling from storage on the machine.$(br2)The same trick builds $(l:create_basics/brass_and_assembly)precision mechanisms$(/l) by looping a deployer, press and more.
